_why: B42-RELEASE-EXACT-SHA and B42-ANDROID-DEBUGGABLE (owner directive 2026-11-14, docs/directives/2026-11-14_b42_owner_decisions_open_issue_accountability.md items 3 and 5): the ONE definition of what must pass, on the exact commit that is packaged, before .github/workflows/release.yml makes a release. Read by tools/release_evidence.py (the release job's checks) and tools/check_android_apk.py (the Android production gate); tests/test_release_gates.py checks release.yml against it. Removing a requirement, or adding an exception, needs the owner's approval recorded in the same commit. A failed, skipped, cancelled, missing or incomplete requirement blocks the release; there is no bypass input.

release_jobs._why: release.yml jobs the release job needs; each must conclude 'success'. sim-gate alone may be 'skipped', and only for the owner-approved private reuse of an earlier passing gate (input reuse_gate_run), which the release job then checks against the diff since that gate's commit (existing SIM-GATE-01 semantics, unchanged).

tests-evidence.what: a complete, fully green Tests (tests.yml) run on exactly this commit: found and reused, awaited, or started once (tools/release_evidence.py)

sim-gate.what: SIM-GATE-01 village simulation suite with the flight recorder (sim-gate.yml)

package.what: six packages from this commit; the Android cells pass tools/check_android_apk.py; the Linux cells launch headless with no script error or leak

smoke-windows.what: the full and demo Windows packages start headless and quit with no script error or leak

tests._why: A full Tests run (not a targeted 'only'/'group' run) on the exact commit. Its jobs (latest attempt) all 'success'; its consolidated validation (tools/ci_consolidate.py, artifact ci-validation-<run>-<attempt>) 'pass' for this commit; every shard's report (artifact ci-report-<run>-<attempt>-shard<N>, latest attempt each) TESTED on this commit, every suite passed, every game suite at or above its floor; shard 0 ran the groups below and each python check below. The number of shards comes from tests.yml at this commit (its plan job's full list).

android._why: The production Android package (B42-ANDROID-DEBUGGABLE): exported with --export-release (Godot's release template), never --export-debug; signed with the owner's permanent release identity (docs/release/ANDROID_SIGNING.md; the certificate's public SHA-256 recorded from Builds 21, 24, 34 and 41); the package ids unchanged; versionCode equal to the build number and versionName 0.1.<n>-test.
